tools.name: classmarker_list_groups_links_exams
tools.description: List the groups, links and exams (tests) this API key can access, with the ids the other tools need (group_id, link_id, link_url_id, test_id, and access_list_id for links with an access-code list). Good first call. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1.json.

tools.name: classmarker_recent_group_results
tools.description: Recent finished test results taken in the key's groups (all groups, all exams), oldest first, PAGED by finish time: test-taker name, email, score, percentage, pass/fail, timing, certificate. Contains personal data: use small pages. Max look-back 3 months. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests p

tools.name: classmarker_recent_link_results
tools.description: Recent finished test results taken through the key's links (all links, all exams), oldest first, PAGED by finish time: test-taker name, email, score, pass/fail, timing, access code, extra tracking fields, IP address, certificate. Contains personal data: use small pages. Max look-back 3 months. Count

tools.name: classmarker_recent_group_exam_results
tools.description: Recent finished results for ONE exam in ONE group (ids from classmarker_list_groups_links_exams), oldest first, PAGED by finish time. Contains personal data: use small pages. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/groups/{group_id}/tests/{test_id}/recent_result

tools.name: classmarker_recent_link_exam_results
tools.description: Recent finished results for the exam of ONE link (ids from classmarker_list_groups_links_exams), oldest first, PAGED by finish time. Contains personal data: use small pages. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/links/{link_id}/tests/{test_id}/recent_results.j

tools.name: classmarker_list_categories
tools.description: List the question-bank categories with their parent categories and ids (needed for creating and updating questions). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/categories.json.

tools.name: classmarker_list_questions
tools.description: List the questions of the question bank, 200 per page (page 1, 2, ...): question text, type, category, points, options, correct options, status. A full page means more may follow, so ask for the next page. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/questions.json?p

tools.name: classmarker_get_question
tools.description: Get one question-bank question by id (ids from classmarker_list_questions). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: GET /v1/questions/{question_id}.json.

tools.name: classmarker_add_access_codes
tools.description: WRITE: add access codes (1-100 per call, up to 255 characters each; a list holds at most 20,000) to a link's access-code list, so those people can start the exam. The access_list_id comes from classmarker_list_groups_links_exams (links[].access_list_id). Only adds; removing codes is not offered. Doe

tools.name: classmarker_create_parent_category
tools.description: WRITE: create a new top-level question category. Returns its parent_category_id. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: POST /v1/categories/parent_category.json.

tools.name: classmarker_update_parent_category
tools.description: WRITE: rename an existing parent category (overwrites its name). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: PUT /v1/categories/parent_category/{parent_category_id}.json.

tools.name: classmarker_create_category
tools.description: WRITE: create a question category under a parent category. Returns its category_id. Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: POST /v1/categories/category.json.

tools.name: classmarker_update_category
tools.description: WRITE: rename a category and/or move it to another parent (overwrites both fields: send the name and parent_category_id you want it to have). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: PUT /v1/categories/category/{category_id}.json.

tools.name: classmarker_create_question
tools.description: WRITE: add a new question to the question bank. Only multiplechoice, multipleresponse, truefalse and essay can be created. Returns the new question_id. For truefalse, give only correct_options ["A"] (True) or ["B"] (False). Counts as one of ClassMarker's 30 requests per hour per API key. API: POST /

tools.name: classmarker_update_question
tools.description: WRITE (overwrites): replace an existing question-bank question. Send the COMPLETE question (type, text, options, correct options, points, feedback), not only the changed fields; read it first with classmarker_get_question. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: classmarker_recent_group_results, classmarker_recent_link_results, classmarker_add_access_codes · Private data: classmarker_list_groups_links_exams, classmarker_recent_group_results, classmarker_recent_link_results, classmarker_recent_group_exam_results, classmarker_recent_link_exam_results, classmarker_list_categories, classmarker_list_questions, classmarker_get_question, classmarker_create_parent_category, classmarker_update_parent_category, classmarker_create_category, classmarker_update_category, classmarker_create_question, classmarker_update_question · Public sink: classmarker_recent_group_results, classmarker_recent_link_results, classmarker_add_access_codes, classmarker_create_parent_category, classmarker_create_category, classmarker_update_category, classmarker_create_question, classmarker_update_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: classmarker_recent_group_results, classmarker_recent_link_results, classmarker_add_access_codes · Private data: classmarker_list_groups_links_exams, classmarker_recent_group_results, classmarker_recent_link_results, classmarker_recent_group_exam_results, classmarker_recent_link_exam_results, classmarker_list_categories, classmarker_list_questions, classmarker_get_question, classmarker_create_parent_category, classmarker_update_parent_category, classmarker_create_category, classmarker_update_category, classmarker_create_question, classmarker_update_question · Public sink: classmarker_recent_group_results, classmarker_recent_link_results, classmarker_add_access_codes, classmarker_create_parent_category, classmarker_create_category, classmarker_update_category, classmarker_create_question, classmarker_update_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
